bin_policy: Partition all200 consecutive committed rows into ten nonoverlapping20-round windows, left-anchored at the first input row; no shifting, filtering, smoothing or outcome-dependent boundaries. Each rate is the exact window count/20.
lineage: Each row lists all20 parentCSV line numbers and all insertion-journal line identities contributing to that count; parent source receipt reconstructs101 consecutive insertion records bracketing the complete200-round interval.
scope: Recorded program/context insertion events per logged round, not per-attempt success probability, elapsed-time speed or independent learning gain.
